name: hoba-monorepo
description: Hiring Obstacles & Barriers Atlas — canonical repo for hoba.work
author: Dmytro Yemelianov <dmytro@hoba.work>

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @hoba/registry build && pnpm --filter @hoba/cli build && pnpm --filter @hoba/mcp build && tsx scripts/build-registry.ts && pnpm --filter hoba-site build
scripts.deploy: pnpm build && wrangler pages deploy site/dist --project-name hoba-work --branch main
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules packages/*/dist packages/*/node_modules site/.astro site/dist site/node_modules
